question.question: Follow the same active ball after the attempt. Establish any goalkeeper touch or change of motion, and distinguish spare balls from the active ball.

outcome_evidence.fact: The moving ball approaches the white runner from his left; its preceding release is not shown.
The ball is immediately in front of p1 as he faces the blond blue defender.
p1 advances with the ball close to his feet between converging blue players.
The ball reappears ahead of p1 after the crowded challenge; he continues chasing it toward the right.
p1 reaches the ball behind the retreating defenders and prepares his striking stride.

target_events.details: Receives the approaching ball and carries it rightward with close touches, changing his body angle under pressure before continuing toward goal. The initial goal-area view does not show the release that supplies him. Brief leg occlusions do not establish an intervening pass or controlled blue possession.

outcome_evidence.fact: p1 lowers his body over the ball while p2 challenges from ahead.
p1 is squeezed between p3 on his left and p2 on his right, both extending legs toward the ball.
p1 remains upright and follows the ball out of the challenge as both defenders retreat.

target_events.details: Contests and protects the ball against p2 and p3, then continues the attack. Individual defensive foot contacts are obscured; no deliberate opponent recovery is established.

contact_evidence.fact: p1 plants beside the ball and brings his striking leg forward; p3 is running across ahead of him.
p1's leg follows through and the ball emerges airborne to the right beyond the defenders.

outcome_evidence.fact: The active ball is airborne beyond the blond defender, traveling toward the goalkeeper's end.
The incoming ball approaches the goalkeeper's raised glove from the left.
The ball reaches the raised glove as the goalkeeper extends toward it.
After reaching the glove, the ball no longer continues its previous rightward motion relative to the goal; it remains above and left of the diving keeper.
The active ball descends outside the left upright while the goalkeeper lands.
The active ball reaches the grass outside the left upright, separate from the stationary ball inside the net.
The active ball is rising after its bounce near the left upright; no entry into the goal is shown.

target_events.details: p1 strikes through the retreating defenders. The exact foot-ball instant is partly masked by p3, but p1's swing and the ball's departure identify the shooter. The goalkeeper touches and redirects the attempt; this is supported by the ball's changed motion, not merely the dive. The ball resting inside the goal is a spare, already stationary while the active shot is still approaching. The active ball drops outside the left upright and bounces; no goal is observed.

Following the glove encounter, the ball's forward motion is checked and it separates above and left of the goalkeeper.

outcome_evidence.fact: The raised glove meets the incoming ball during the goalkeeper's extension.
The ball remains separate above the falling goalkeeper, outside the left side of the goal.

events.details: Raised-glove parry/save followed by a diving landing. The ball is deflected rather than held or deliberately controlled. The stationary ball inside the net is not this saved shot.
